snippet.title: Learn Korean with Single’s Inferno
snippet.description:
✏️진짜? — jin-jja?

👉 Koreans use “진짜?” in three different ways (and more) depending on the situation!

⸻

1️⃣ Emphasis = really / so / very
이거 진짜 맛있어.
i-geo jin-jja ma-si-sseo
→ “This is really good.”

⸻

2️⃣ Agreement while listening = seriously / I know, right
👩🏻: 오늘 너무 춥다.
o-neul neo-mu chup-da 
(It’s so cold today.)
🧔🏻‍♂️: 진짜 🥶
jin-jja…
→ “Seriously…” / “I know, right…”

⸻

3️⃣ Surprise (놀람) = really? / no way / for real?
👩🏻 나 내일 한국 가.
na nae-il hanguk ga 
(I’m going to Korea tomorrow.)
🧔🏻‍♂️ 진짜??
jin-jja??
→ “Really??” / “No way!”

#learnkorean #singlesinferno5 #netflix
